provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning an EV Charging Station

voice_persona.name: 风口生意的冷静拆账人
voice_persona.description: 一位替你把热生意的账本翻出来的解说者：先顺着你的时代红利幻想推到顶点，再用「镜头关掉、表格打开」切换到行业地面；善用日常类比（瓶装水/自动售货机/磁铁）解释陌生机制，用「指标+窗口+精确值」的统计重锤建立可信；不泼冷水也不站台，只把两种结局的账并排摆给你看
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 像一个已经调研完回来的朋友：开场用「你」代入幻想与预算错觉，主体用第三人称解剖行业，判词时刻回到「你」的投资处境
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自行业追踪机构数据、政府计划条款、可复算的情景账本与生态角色分析，而非身份

tone_profile.certainty_style: 统计给精确值与窗口，机制用因果句，收益用情景示例；不为风口唱赞歌也不唱衰

rhythm_rules.rule: 枚举段用编号逐项推进（The most direct one...The second stream is...Third is...）
rhythm_rules.function: 让多条收入流/清单项可清点可记忆

rhythm_rules.rule: 类比之后必给原则句（Nobody is buying the water...）
rhythm_rules.function: 把比喻固定为可迁移的机制

rhythm_rules.rule: 核心指标按「定义→全国均值→健康基准」三步给
rhythm_rules.function: 让观众同时获得概念、现实与目标

rhythm_rules.rule: 重场段开头用路标预告（第一堵墙/让新手沉默的轨道）
rhythm_rules.function: 长片中持续制造注意力峰值

rhythm_rules.rule: 判词用短句独立成拍（They do not. Not really. / Everything else is secondary.）

pause_and_emphasis: 反转前用极短否定句（They do not. Not really.）
段落用路标句预告重要性（Here is where most investors hit their first wall.）
判词前用对照句蓄势（One makes money, one loses it.）
transition_style: 镜头/表格转向（when the cameras are off and the spreadsheets are open）
预算错觉对仗（You budget for X. You forget about everything else.）
对照实验开场（Two identical X... One makes money, one loses it.）
视角引导（do not look at the X. Look at who owns the Y.）
否定类比收尾（not like owning a vending machine）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 低频：集中在开场幻想段与类比处，数据与风险段不用
placement_rules: 开场把被动收入幻想演到「几乎不用想」的荒谬边缘
用瓶装水/自动售货机类日常类比制造会心一笑
avoid_rules: 不嘲笑亏钱或倒闭的运营商
不在隐藏成本与亏损情景段使用幽默

language_patterns.formula: You find a X, bolt some Y to the ground... You collect the cash automatically.
language_patterns.purpose: 替观众演出躺赚幻想，为反转蓄力

language_patterns.formula: like owning a [历史造富资产] in [年份] when [历史趋势]
language_patterns.purpose: 把新机会嫁接到公认的历史造富时刻

language_patterns.formula: when the cameras are off and the spreadsheets are open
language_patterns.purpose: 宣告幻想时段结束、账本时段开始

language_patterns.formula: Some operators are genuinely making money. Many more are quietly losing it.
language_patterns.purpose: 把行业真相压成一个悬念

language_patterns.formula: People assume that [生意] sell [商品]. They do not. Not really.
language_patterns.purpose: 先立默认假设再用最短否定拆掉

language_patterns.formula: Nobody is buying the [便宜商品]. They are buying the immediate availability of it.
language_patterns.purpose: 用日常商品解释陌生生意的溢价逻辑

language_patterns.formula: The most direct one is X... The second stream is Y... Third is Z.
language_patterns.purpose: 用编号清单展示收入的叠加结构

language_patterns.formula: The faster the X, the more it costs, the more it earns..., and the more brutal...
language_patterns.purpose: 把多变量关系压成一句可记规则

language_patterns.formula: You budget for the X. You forget about everything else.
language_patterns.purpose: 点破新手预算里看不见的窟窿

language_patterns.formula: [变量] is not one factor among many, it is the factor. Everything else is secondary.
language_patterns.purpose: 把关键因素升格为唯一因素

language_patterns.formula: earns exactly $0 per hour, but it does not cost $0 per hour
language_patterns.purpose: 用悖论句开启闲置成本解剖

language_patterns.formula: The [设备] does not need to be profitable on its own. The [设备] is the magnet.
language_patterns.purpose: 把亏损工具重定义为获客资产

language_patterns.formula: The difference... is not luck. It is A, B, and C.
language_patterns.purpose: 把结局差异归因到可学习的变量

language_patterns.formula: owning a X is not like owning a [简单自动设备]. It is a [属性三连] business.
language_patterns.purpose: 拆轻快类比、给沉重真身

preferred_traits: 指标全称+统计窗口（Q2 2026 national average utilization rate）
日常商品类比（bottled water、vending machine、magnet、toll booth）
单设备/单口的微观演算（$80,000 per port、$7,000 per month）
avoid_traits: 技术名词不解释直接使用

forbidden_style.rule: 行业统计必须注明口径与统计窗口
亏损情景与隐藏成本段不使用幽默
不把行业热度描述成骗局，也不把风口描述成保证
禁止编造数据、政策条款或统计
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
